description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty, which is a custom injector component for the HTMLPurifier library. It contains methods to prepare the injector with configuration and context, and to handle HTML element tokens, specifically to remove empty or whitespace-only elements like <colgroup> and other tags without meaningful content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty
classes.description: A class that removes empty HTML elements during purification, by inspecting tokens and potentially removing elements that contain only whitespace or are otherwise empty.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, setting up an attribute validator.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Analyzes an HTML start token, determines if the element is empty or only whitespace, and removes it if appropriate.
